card.name: Second word of proper institution or street names
card.fires_on: The closing word of a proper name, such as College after a Cambridge or Dublin college name, or Road/Avenue after a street name. It also fires on General or a comma after a title.

modes.label: College names
modes.description: The word College right after a named college in biographical text.
modes.example: He received his M.A. in 1743 from Trinity<< College>> in Dublin

modes.label: Street names
modes.description: Road, Ave or Avenue ending a street name in an address.

modes.label: Titles of office
modes.description: General or a comma after a job title that is followed by an organization.
modes.example: Commanding<< General>> of the Hawaiian Department.

card.writes: The promoted and suppressed tokens look unrelated, so there is no clear output effect.
card.plain: It marks the last word of a named college, street or office title, such as College or Avenue.
